title: browser and video sound shared with the radio

clauses.text: Picture and sound of a video played in the browser pane stay together, and the radio is shared with it

steps.do: Play a video in the browser pane with the radio also on, then press the volume key once.
steps.expect: Picture and sound are together (no obvious lip-sync delay). The radio is quieter during a speech cue and moves with the one volume.
